tasks.label: Build and Run Flex
args: $src = '${file}'; $folder = Split-Path -Parent $src; $name = Split-Path -Leaf $folder; $c = Join-Path $folder ($name + '.c'); $exe = Join-Path $folder ($name + '.exe'); & 'D:\Ayu\CSIT\Flex Windows\Lex\bin\flex.exe' ('-o' + $c) $src; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'D:\Ayu\CSIT\Flex Windows\gcc\bin\gcc.exe' $c -o $exe; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $exe
